'''Hamelin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Senior Commander/Legends|senior commander]] who served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was in charge of an Alliance [[Aargonar 3 rebel base|base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aargonar 3]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] might conquered the planet, Hamelin's forces fled to a remote [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]]. He later was in command of a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] squadron group who raided Imperial convoys following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|destruction]] of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star I]].
